methods.label: Use the sample center
methods.explanation: The regression line passes through the sample center \((\bar{x},\bar{y})\), so \(a=\bar{y}-b\bar{x}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the standard sample-center property of the fitted regression line and an elementary equality rearrangement.
